notes: Vector store on the Qdrant catalog app (Databases category). Field names from clearml_apps/db_apps/qdrant/qdrant.app.conf 1.17.3; the package is not among the app zips in suse-lab/apps-to-upload, so check that the app is installed. The app routes HTTP port 6333 through the application gateway and snapshots /qdrant/storage; to keep the index across a restart, launch a clone with continue_session set to the previous instance id.
